post.summary: Submit an Order to NBN for a NCAS Product
post.description:
NCAS Products include: FTTB, FTTC and FTTN

A successful submission will result in an "Acknowledged"             response.  The order status can be checked when viewing                 the Order Details.
Use the Callbacks API to register a callback URL for receiving             notifications when the order is "Accepted", "Complete" or                 "Rejected".

REQUIRED / CONDITIONAL FIELDS>
 - Always Required:
    ~ `location_id`
    ~ `bandwidth_product_sku`
    ~ `restoration_sla_sku`
    ~ `order_reference`
    ~ `copper_pair_id` either the CPI or "NEW"
 - The `end_user_type` is "Business":
    ~ `related_party_id` must refer to a valid NBN BIZ Record                 (see Party API)
 - New Line Order
    ~ `appointment_id` field must refer to a valid                  "Standard Install" appointment for the Location                 (see Appointment API)
 - Line Service Class #11
    ~ `appointment_id` field must refer to a valid                  "Standard Install" appointment for the Location                 (see Appointment API)
 - Line Service Class 12 Inactive:
    ~ `appointment_id` where `demand_type` = "Standard Install"
    ~ `exchange_pair_connection` must be "false"
    ~ `installation_workforce` must be "NBN Co Install" if FTTN
    ~ `install_option_jumpering` must be "true"
    ~ `install_option_central_splitter` if FTTN
 - Line Service Class 12 Active
    ~ `appointment_id` where `demand_type` = "Standard Install"                 if `install_option_central_splitter` = "true"
    ~ `appointment_id` where `demand_type` = "Non EU Jumpering"                 if FTTN and `install_option_central_splitter` = "false"
    ~ `pots_interconnect`
    ~ `exchange_pair_connection`
    ~ `install_option_jumpering` must be "true"
    ~ `installation_workforce` must be "NBN Co Install" if FTTN
    ~ `install_option_central_splitter` if FTTN
 - Line Service Class 13 / 34 with Service Transfer:
    ~ `transfer_type`
    ~ `service_ref`
    ~ `customer_authority_date`
    ~ `informed_consent`
    ~ `local_number_porting`
    ~ `uni_vlan_id` if `vlan_mode` is "Tagged"
 - Line Service Class 13 where `install_option_central_splitter` = "true":
    ~ `appointment_id` where `demand_type` = "Additional Install"

NOTES>

post.summary: Submit an Order to NBN for a NWAS Product
post.description:
NCAS Products include: Wireless and Fixed Wireless

A successful submission will result in an "Acknowledged"             response.  The order status can be checked when viewing                 the Order Details.
Use the Callbacks API to register a callback URL for             receiving notifications when the order is "Accepted",                 "Complete" or "Rejected".

 - Always Required:
    ~ `location_id`
    ~ `bandwidth_product_sku`
    ~ `restoration_sla_sku`
    ~ `order_reference`
    ~ `ntd_id` either the NTD ID or "NEW"
 - The `end_user_type` is "Business":
    ~ `related_party_id` must refer to a valid NBN BIZ Record                 (see Party API)
 - Line Service Class 5
    ~ `appointment_id` where `demand_type` is "Standard Install"
    ~ `installation_workforce`
 - Line Service Class 6 when connecting subsequent service
    ~ `ntd_id` is "NEW"
    ~ `appointment_id` where `demand_type` is "Standard Install"
 - Line Service Class 6 with Service Transfer
    ~ `transfer_type`
    ~ `service_ref`
    ~ `customer_authority_date` if `transfer_type` is                 "Service Transfer" or "Connect Outstanding"
    ~ `informed_consent`
    ~ `local_number_porting`
    ~ `unid_port_id` where value is not "0"
    ~ `from_port_id` if `overlap_period` is "4"
    ~ `uni_vlan_id` if `vlan_mode` is "Tagged"

NOTES>
 - Service Class 5 is not supported
 - Service Class 5 is under development
 - Service Class 6 is under development
 - The IP Address, VRF/subnet and Protocol are to be set via              the Provisioning API after this order has Completed

serviceabilityClass.description:
The servicability classes are:

0 - Planned to be serviced by Fibre in the future (boundary status isnt In Service yet)
1 - Serviceable by Fibre, no drop or NTD in place
2 - Serviceable by Fibre, drop in place, no NTD in place
3 - Serviceable by Fibre, drop and NTD in place
4 - Planned to be serviced by Wireless
5 - Serviceable by Wireless, CPE not installed
6 - Serviceable by Wireless, CPE installed
7 - Planned to be serviced by Satellite
8 - Serviceable by Satellite, Satellite - NTD not installed
9 - Serviceable by Satellite, Satellite - NTD installed
10 - Planned to be serviceable by Copper
11 - Serviceable by copper, active node present
12 - Serviceable by copper, jumpering is required
13 - Serviceable by copper, infrastructure in place
20 - Planned to be serviced by HFC, outside plant does not exist
21 - Serviceable by HFC, the location has a street TAP but requires a lead-in, PCD, internal tie cable, and wall-plate/socket
22 - Serviceable by HFC, the location has a street TAP, lead-in & PCD in place, but no internal tie-cables with wall plates/sockets
23 - Serviceable by HFC, the location has a wall-plate/socket but no HFC NTD
24 - Serviceable by HFC, Location has a wall-plate/socket & HFC NTD and is Ready to Connect
30 - Planned to be serviceable by FTTC
31 - Serviceable by FTTC, no line available (NCD required)
32 - Serviceable by FTTC, cut-in required (NCD required)
33 - Serviceable by FTTC, cut-in complete (NCD required)
34 - Serviceable by FTTC, infrastructure in place (Check NCD status)
